# AWS Batch

Persist regional compute-environment, queue and revisioned container-definition metadata without provisioning or running jobs.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `batch` |
| Signing name | `batch` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2016-08-10` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 14 of 48 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-batch) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only: no SubmitJob/DescribeJobs/ListJobs/CancelJob/TerminateJob, scheduler, Docker/ECS/EKS jobs, provisioning/autoscaling, image pulls, IAM role existence/trust/permissions or execution readiness. VALID means valid local metadata.
- Only MANAGED EC2 or UNMANAGED are supported. Managed x86 choices are finite c5/m5/r5 families/sizes, optimal and default_x86_64; Fargate, Spot, ARM, EKS, ECS managed instances, launch templates, custom AMIs, instance tags, scaling policies and infrastructure updates are excluded.
- Create environment supports name/type/state/serviceRole/tags and selected computeResources. Both types require ENABLED at creation (also the omitted-state default); DISABLED returns ClientException/400 without storing a record. Update accepts ENABLED/DISABLED and supports state/serviceRole and minvCpus/maxvCpus/desiredvCpus only. Desired capacity cannot decrease or leave the retained bounds; bounds alone do not invoke a scheduler.
- Definitions support container/EC2 only; retry/timeout, GPU, multinode, volumes, secrets, privileges, EKS/ECS advanced properties and tag propagation are absent. Unsupported inputs fail explicitly including false/null/empty.
- Descriptions default to all definition statuses and return all matching revisions, rather than latest active name resolution. Explicit definition lists require revisioned identifiers and cannot combine with other parameters. Inactive history is retained indefinitely locally.
- Scheduling policies, fair-share capacity, service environments, consumable resources and advanced queue actions are future scope.
- CloudFormation supports name/type/state/serviceRole/computeResources/tags for environments, name/state/priority/order/tags for queues and name/type/parameters/container/platform/tags for definitions. Compute config/role/type/name changes replace the environment; definition metadata changes create another revision and retire the previous revision after success.
- Explicitly named environment/queue replacements need distinct names to coexist; reusing the same name fails safely. CloudFormation environments must be created ENABLED. ReplaceComputeEnvironment=false and infrastructure-update policies are excluded.
- No dedicated mutation console; the [records workflow](../guides/batch-records.md) lists exact members, defaults, finite limits, reference/version rules and executable CLI examples.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `CreateComputeEnvironment` | `POST /v1/createcomputeenvironment` |
| `CreateJobQueue` | `POST /v1/createjobqueue` |
| `DeleteComputeEnvironment` | `POST /v1/deletecomputeenvironment` |
| `DeleteJobQueue` | `POST /v1/deletejobqueue` |
| `DeregisterJobDefinition` | `POST /v1/deregisterjobdefinition` |
| `DescribeComputeEnvironments` | `POST /v1/describecomputeenvironments` |
| `DescribeJobDefinitions` | `POST /v1/describejobdefinitions` |
| `DescribeJobQueues` | `POST /v1/describejobqueues` |
| `ListTagsForResource` | `GET /v1/tags/{resourceArn}` |
| `RegisterJobDefinition` | `POST /v1/registerjobdefinition` |
| `TagResource` | `POST /v1/tags/{resourceArn}` |
| `UntagResource` | `DELETE /v1/tags/{resourceArn}` |
| `UpdateComputeEnvironment` | `POST /v1/updatecomputeenvironment` |
| `UpdateJobQueue` | `POST /v1/updatejobqueue` |
